# Mainsail Painting

> House painting for Cape Cod and South Shore homes: interior and exterior painting, kitchen cabinet refinishing, deck refinishing, wood staining, sheet rock and plaster, and wallpaper installation.

Mainsail Painting (Mainsail Painting LLC) serves Cape Cod & South Shore, MA. Call or text Vinny at (508) 593-1087. Website: https://mainsailpainting.com/

## Services

- [Deck Refinishing & Staining on Cape Cod, MA](https://mainsailpainting.com/deck-refinishing/): Deck refinishing on Cape Cod and the South Shore: cleaned, sanded and sealed with stains made for the Cape’s weather. Visit within 24 hours.
- [Exterior House Painting on Cape Cod, MA](https://mainsailpainting.com/exterior-painting/): Exterior house painting for Cape Cod and South Shore homes, oceanfront to historic. Coatings chosen for salt air and humidity. Visit within 24 hours.
- [Interior Painting on Cape Cod, MA](https://mainsailpainting.com/interior-painting/): Interior painting for Cape Cod and South Shore homes: walls, ceilings, trim and doors, help with colors and sheens. Visit within 24 hours.
- [Cabinet Painting & Refinishing on Cape Cod, MA](https://mainsailpainting.com/kitchen-cabinet-refinishing/): Kitchen cabinet painting and refinishing on Cape Cod: keep your cabinets, skip the demolition. Done in days with low-VOC finishes made for cabinetry.
- [Sheet Rock Installation & Plaster, Cape Cod](https://mainsailpainting.com/sheet-rock-installation/): Sheet rock installation on Cape Cod for new builds, remodels and repairs: flat surfaces and clean corners, ready for paint, plaster or wallpaper.
- [Wallpaper Installation on Cape Cod, MA](https://mainsailpainting.com/wallpaper-installation/): Wallpaper installation on Cape Cod: grasscloth, silk, metallics and murals, hung with matched, invisible seams. Surface prep included.
- [Wood Staining on Cape Cod, MA](https://mainsailpainting.com/wood-staining/): Wood staining on Cape Cod, inside and out: stair rails, trim, historic doors, siding, decks and beams, in tones matched to your home.

- [How Long Does Exterior Paint Last on a Cape Cod Home?](https://mainsailpainting.com/blog/how-long-does-exterior-paint-last/): A good paint job on wood siding often lasts 7 to 10 years. Learn what shortens it on Cape Cod, how often to repaint, and the signs it is time. (updated 2026-11-22)
- [When Is the Best Time to Paint a House Exterior on Cape Cod?](https://mainsailpainting.com/blog/best-time-to-paint-house-exterior-cape-cod/): On Cape Cod, the dependable window for exterior paint runs from late May through September. See the temperatures, dew rules and data behind it. (updated 2026-11-20)
